decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD builds directly on the retailer's existing knowledge of its music assortment and customer base, so management can read its early sales results and sees little reason to withdraw it after one year, even though physical CD demand is declining.

The illustrated music release series extends related knowledge of music products and still had its own dedicated page in 2018, so management keeps it to keep learning from its results, although its novel format makes it somewhat riskier than the compilation.
